javascript-off-on.method: two captures of the same page, JavaScript disabled and enabled, joined side by side and labeled

network-tab-json.method: Chrome for Testing 154 driven by Selenium 4.49, headed on Xvfb, DevTools docked right and operated with real clicks (xdotool), grabbed with ImageMagick import
network-tab-json.note: After scrolling, the Fetch/XHR filter lists quotes?page=1 to page=4; Preview shows page 2's JSON.

playwright-codegen.method: playwright codegen --target python (Playwright 1.63, its bundled Chrome for Testing 153), headed on Xvfb, grabbed with ImageMagick import
playwright-codegen.note: After two recorded clicks (the tag "change", then an "(about)" link), hovering the author's name shows the locator codegen would use.

selenium-chrome-for-testing.method: webdriver.Chrome() with Selenium 4.49 on a machine with no Chrome; Selenium Manager downloaded Chrome for Testing 154; headed on Xvfb, grabbed with ImageMagick import
selenium-chrome-for-testing.note: The comic was Stargazing 5; its hover text shows because the pointer rested on it.

view-source-js.method: Chrome for Testing 154 driven by Selenium 4.49, headed on a virtual display (Xvfb), View Source grabbed with ImageMagick import; the top of the source through line 43
view-source-js.note: The quotes sit in a script element as `var data = [...]`.

xkcd-inspect.method: Chrome for Testing 154, headed on Xvfb, right-click > Inspect on the comic with real clicks (xdotool), DevTools docked right, grabbed with ImageMagick import
xkcd-inspect.note: The selected img has the hover joke in its title attribute and the comic's name in alt.
